name: Google Antigravity

tiers.name: Individual

limits.quota: Meaningful weekly quota, refreshed weekly (no 5-hour refresh)
limits.rateLimit: Basic weekly rate limits per model

estimatedTokenBudget.assumptions: Research-based estimate: ~150K tokens/agent task * ~25 agent tasks/mo. Official quotas are undocumented and 'correlated with the amount of work done by the agent', so treat as low confidence

tiers.notes: Free tier; no purchased AI-credit overage

tiers.name: Google AI Pro

limits.quota: High quota, refreshed every 5 hours until weekly limit reached
limits.rateLimit: Higher weekly rate limit per model
limits.creditOverage: AI credits consumed at standard Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform pricing ('Never' or 'Always' toggle)

estimatedTokenBudget.description: 5-hour refresh quota with weekly caps (~45M tokens/mo)
estimatedTokenBudget.assumptions: Research-based estimate: ~150K tokens/agent task * ~300 agent tasks/mo. No official task counts published; low confidence

tiers.notes: Includes purchased AI-credit overage above baseline quota

tiers.name: Google AI Ultra

limits.quota: Highest quota, refreshed every 5 hours until weekly limit reached
limits.rateLimit: Highest weekly rate limit per model
limits.creditOverage: AI credits consumed at standard GEAP consumption pricing

estimatedTokenBudget.assumptions: Research-based estimate: ~150K tokens/agent task * ~1,200 agent tasks/mo. No official task counts published; low confidence

tiers.notes: Daily-driver tier; docs note access to third-party models (also available on non-Enterprise tiers)

tiers.name: Organization (Google Cloud)

limits.billing: Consumption-based pricing via Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
limits.governance: Google Cloud Terms of Service; Cloud project integration
limits.exclusion: Claude and GPT-OSS reasoning models not available

estimatedTokenBudget.description: Pay-per-use at actual GEAP consumption rates - no fixed monthly token bundle
estimatedTokenBudget.assumptions: Token cost equals actual API consumption; included for tier completeness, not comparable to fixed-quota tiers

tiers.notes: Included in select Gemini Enterprise app subscriptions (rolling out)

gotchas: Quotas are NOT token- or task-metered: rate limits are 'correlated with the amount of work done by the agent', so harder tasks consume allowance faster
No official task or token counts are published; estimatedTokenBudget figures are research estimates and low confidence
Pro/Ultra use a 5-hour refresh until the weekly cap is hit; free tier refreshes weekly only
AI-credit overage is billed at standard Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform consumption pricing once baseline quota is exhausted
Using third-party software/tools against Antigravity OAuth (e.g. OpenClaw) breaches the ToS and can lead to account suspension
No BYOK or bring-your-own-endpoint support, even on paid tiers
Google Cloud/Enterprise usage is governed by Google Cloud terms instead of the consumer terms
tosHighlights: Interactions are recorded and used to evaluate and improve Google/Alphabet ML; in-settings opt-out available, deletion via antigravity-support@google.com
Selecting Claude models binds you to Anthropic commercial terms in addition to Google's
You are solely responsible for AI Agent actions, access grants, and production supervision
dataTraining: Interactions used for ML improvement with in-settings opt-out; deletion on request via antigravity-support@google.com
